subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan – EdgeFin / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@edgefin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan – EdgeFin / Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — great conversation today, thanks again for the time. Per our discovery, I pulled together a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture milestones, owners, and a proposed target close date so we can align with your procurement timeline. Key points from our call: 

- Business driver: real-time inference for market surveillance to reduce false positives and improve detection latency.
- Target initial scope: 2 models in production, ~200 req/s, US deployment.
- Success metrics: 99th pct latency under 150ms, 30% cost per token reduction vs cloud baseline.

Draft MAP overview (see attachment EdgeFin_MAP_Draft_20260110.xlsx):
- Milestone 1 (PO / Commercial approval): EdgeFin procurement — target: 2026-01-29
- Milestone 2 (Legal review / Redlines): EdgeFin legal + Redwood legal — target: 2026-01-18
- Milestone 3 (Dedicated provisioning & POC): Redwood infra — target: 2026-02-05
- Milestone 4 (Pilot validation & sign-off): EdgeFin product — target: 2026-02-19

Proposed responsibilities: EdgeFin procurement (PO & commercial sign-off), EdgeFin legal (contract redlines), Redwood legal (SLA/TPP review), Redwood delivery (provisioning & onboarding).

Proposed target close date: 2026-01-31 for contract signature (allows procurement to raise PO and schedule provisioning). If your procurement needs a later signature date, please flag which deadline is most important — PO issuance or executed signature.

Dependencies / blockers we called out: final security questionnaire (we'll send SOC2 evidence by COB Monday), KMS integration notes for keys, and your procurement/finance approval cadence.

Next steps: please confirm (1) that the MAP owners look right, and (2) whether the 2026-01-31 signature target is feasible on your side. Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if that helps tighten timelines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Attachment: EdgeFin_MAP_Draft_20260110.xlsx

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan – EdgeFin / Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa, and thanks for the clear MAP. A few quick notes from procurement / finance: 

- Procurement needs final commercial terms and an approved SOW to issue a PO. Our procurement timeline is tight — they prefer PO issuance by 2026-01-28.
- Legal has requested one week for redlines once it receives the first draft; given holidays last week our internal legal lead is asking for contract signature by 2026-02-05 rather than 2026-01-31.
- CFO (cc'ed Nina) wants clarity on billing cadence and an early estimate of committed spend.

We can probably accelerate if Redwood legal can provide counter-redlines quickly and if we can get an internal SOW stub to procurement this week. Is Redwood able to prioritize legal review and provide a clean commercial/term summary for procurement consumption? Also — can you confirm whether an executed signature by 2026-01-31 is a hard requirement on your side or just a preferred date?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a short alignment call.

Best,
Sam Lee
Head of Product | EdgeFin
sam.lee@edgefin.com

Folks — forwarding Sam's note. Procurement is asking for PO by 1/28 and legal is pushing signature to 2/5 unless we can get redlines sooner. Our customer prefers an earlier signature (1/31) but procurement timeline is the gating item. Proposed options: 

1) Accelerate Redwood legal engagement and offer a single round of negotiated redlines by EOD 2026-01-18. If legal can meet that, we can push for 1/31 signature. 
2) Offer procurement enablement: provide a one-page commercial summary + SOW stub for EdgeFin procurement to issue a conditional PO by 1/28 (PO triggers provisioning schedule).
3) If neither is feasible, accept 2/05 signature and map provisioning to start immediately after sign.

Ask: Aditya — can you own Redwood legal coordination to commit to a target turnaround? Ben — can you prepare a draft SOW stub (1 page) that I can send to EdgeFin procurement by EOD tomorrow? Lauren — can you support with billing/committed spend estimates for the CFO?

I'll propose we offer to run procurement kickoff call with their procurement team to clear questions early. If we show flexibility on a PO-first approach, we can protect the 1/31 operational timeline (i.e., provision on PO + execute contract by 2/5).

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa / Lauren — quick update from our side after procurement sync: procurement can issue a conditional PO by 2026-01-28 provided Redwood supplies a SOW stub and a short commercial summary (line items, billing cadence, committed spend estimate). Our legal team will commit to providing redlines if Redwood legal can provide a counter by 2026-01-18 EOD. If both items are met, procurement will route for signature with an internal target of 2026-01-31.

We're attaching the PO form to make it easier (EdgeFin_PO_Form.pdf). This aligns with our internal dependencies: PO issuance (1/28) -> signature routing (1/31). If Redwood legal cannot meet the 1/18 redline deadline, we'll need to push signature to 2/05.

Confirming: EdgeFin is signed up to aim for 1/31 provided the two items above are delivered. Please confirm you'll send the SOW stub and commercial summary by EOD 1/14 and that Redwood legal will prioritize redlines with a target counter by 1/18. If that works, we'll lock the MAP with the milestone dates and owners.
